result.answer: LinkedIn offers three Sales Navigator plans: Core, Advanced, and Advanced Plus. However, the compare plans page (business.linkedin.com/sell/sales-navigator/compare-plans) does not display specific monthly prices directly. The Core plan links to a pricing page showing monthly costs, the Advanced plan also has a pricing link, and Advanced Plus requires requesting a demo for pricing. The exact monthly prices were not extracted due to time constraints.
result.blocker_detail: The Sales Navigator compare plans page lists three plans (Core, Advanced, Advanced Plus) but prices are accessed via separate links. Core and Advanced have 'View pricing' links, while Advanced Plus requires a demo request. Specific monthly dollar amounts were not retrieved before time expired.
